jobs.occupation: Order picker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection.

• You contribute to achieving targets.

Our client is a well-established international organization operating across multiple regions, with a complex and geographically distributed business environment.

As part of an ongoing technology and transformation journey, the company is investing in the modernization of its digital landscape, infrastructure services, cybersecurity capabilities, cloud technologies, and operational resilience. Technology plays a key role in supporting business performance, operational continuity, and long-term growth.

The organization combines the stability of an established international business with an evolving operating model and a strong focus on continuous improvement.

To support this transformation, they are looking for their future Global Infrastructure & Network Services Manager.

The position offers an international working environment, exposure to strategic initiatives, and the opportunity to contribute to major technology decisions while collaborating with teams across multiple countries and functions.

Jobomschrijving

As Global Infrastructure & Network Services Manager, you will be responsible for defining and delivering the global infrastructure and network services strategy while ensuring operational excellence across the organization.

Infrastructure & Network Strategy

• Define and execute the global infrastructure and network roadmap.
• Establish technology standards, governance frameworks, and best practices.
• Drive modernization initiatives across network, cloud, datacenter, workplace, and infrastructure services.
• Ensure alignment between technology priorities and business objectives.

Service Ownership & Operations

• Oversee the delivery and lifecycle management of global infrastructure and network services.
• Ensure high levels of availability, security, performance, and reliability across all environments.
• Monitor service quality and lead continuous improvement initiatives.
• Support business-critical operations through resilient and scalable infrastructure solutions.

Security & Risk Management

• Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to ensure infrastructure and network services meet security standards.
• Support compliance, risk mitigation, disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives.
• Contribute to the protection of both corporate and operational environments.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

• Manage relationships with external service providers and technology partners.
• Oversee contract performance, service quality, and budget management.
• Work closely with business leaders, enterprise architects, and regional IT teams to prioritize initiatives and investments.

Leadership

• Lead and develop a global team of infrastructure and network professionals.
• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
• Drive capability development and succession planning within the organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong infrastructure and networking expertise with strategic leadership capabilities and experience operating in large international environments.

Experience

• Proven experience managing enterprise infrastructure and network services.
• Strong background in multinational or highly distributed organizations.
• Experience leading geographically dispersed technical teams.
• Demonstrated success managing third-party providers and large-scale service delivery environments.

Technical Knowledge

• Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure technologies.
• Solid expertise in networking, connectivity, cloud platforms, and cybersecurity principles.
• Experience with LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless networks, firewalls, remote access solutions, and cloud networking.
• Knowledge of infrastructure governance, service management, and operational excellence frameworks.
• Familiarity with industrial, manufacturing, or operational technology environments is considered an advantage.

Leadership & Soft Skills

• Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to influence senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
• Results-oriented mindset with a focus on service quality and continuous improvement.
• Comfortable navigating complex international environments and transformation programs.

Languages skills 

• English is mandatory, as it is the primary working language within the international organization and across global stakeholders.
• French or Dutch is strongly preferred, given the Brussels-based location of the role and the interactions with local and regional teams.

Our client is a leading professional services organization operating a network of accounting and advisory offices across Belgium. Driven by strong growth ambitions and a continuous focus on innovation, the company has invested significantly in digital transformation, process excellence, and modern technologies to support both its employees and clients.

As part of its long-term strategy, the company is building a future-oriented environment where technology and people work hand in hand. The Digital Team plays a key role in this journey by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, standardize ways of working, and unlock the potential of emerging technologies across the business.

To support this journey, they are seeking a Digital & Process Expert (AI) to play a key role in shaping and delivering their digital transformation initiatives.

Jobomschrijving

As a Digital Expert, you will play a central role in shaping and accelerating the organization's digital and AI transformation agenda.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Analyzing existing business processes across accounting offices and identifying opportunities for optimization, standardization, and automation.
• Defining future-state processes and selecting the most appropriate technologies to support them.
• Driving the adoption of digital tools such as accounting, reporting, workflow, and collaboration platforms.
• Identifying and implementing AI-powered solutions that enhance productivity, reduce manual work, and improve service quality.
• Monitoring emerging trends in Artificial Intelligence, machine learning, automation, and digital innovation, and translating these into concrete business opportunities.
• Designing and coordinating change management and implementation strategies for large-scale transformation projects.
• Acting as a trusted advisor to management and business stakeholders regarding digitalization initiatives and process improvements.
• Collaborating closely with key users and local offices to ensure successful adoption of new technologies.
• Supporting continuous improvement initiatives through feedback collection, process reviews, and performance monitoring.
• Building and facilitating internal communities to share best practices, success stories, and knowledge related to digital tools and AI applications.
• Serving as the link between operational teams, leadership, and technology partners to ensure digital initiatives deliver measurable business value.

This position combines business analysis, process improvement, technology consulting, AI enablement, and change management in a highly visible role.

The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen with a genuine passion for technology, digital innovation, and Artificial Intelligence.

You are likely to bring:

• Several years of experience in a digital transformation, business analysis, process improvement, consulting, or change management role.
• A solid understanding of accounting workflows, financial processes, or professional services environments. Experience within accountancy is considered a strong asset.
• A strong interest in AI technologies and their practical application in business environments.
• Experience working with digital platforms, workflow tools, automation solutions, or business software ecosystems.
• Excellent analytical skills with the ability to identify inefficiencies and translate complex challenges into practical solutions.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
• A collaborative mindset and the ability to engage users at all levels of the organization.
• A pragmatic and hands-on approach, balancing long-term strategic objectives with short-term business needs.
• The ability to explain complex technological concepts, including AI-related topics, in a simple and accessible manner.
• Curiosity, adaptability, and a continuous improvement mindset.
• Willingness to travel regularly to various offices and work closely with local teams.
• Professional proficiency in Dutch and English, with French considered a valuable asset.

Most importantly, you enjoy helping people embrace change and are motivated by the opportunity to make technology and AI create tangible business impact.

Business Analyst (Junior or Senior) — Ghent
 

Are you ready to learn fast and make a real impact, working side by side with a small, close-knit team in Ghent? At Corlutions, we've been helping companies grow with Odoo since 2019, and we're expanding our team to do even more of that.
 

 
 

About Corlutions
 

Corlutions is a digitalization partner for small and medium-sized enterprises, specializing in Odoo-based solutions that help organizations reduce costs and increase revenue. We work closely with clients across sectors like manufacturing, construction, wholesale, and finance — always living by our principle: "Together is better."
 

 
 

What is a Business Analyst at Corlutions?
 

As a Business Analyst, your mission is to help our clients optimize their business processes through smart, well-implemented software — primarily Odoo and Business Intelligence. You'll gather and document business requirements, and translate them into clear functional specifications that guide every project.
 

You'll work closely with clients to ensure optimal use of Odoo apps such as Accounting, Point of Sales, eCommerce, Manufacturing, Inventory, Projects, Websites, Sales and more. By diving into your client's needs and processes, and providing personalized training, you'll become the go-to expert for their management solutions.
 

In your first weeks, you'll get comprehensive training before jumping into your first projects — always with the support of your mentor and colleagues. As you gain experience, you'll gain autonomy too. Collaboration stays key throughout: you'll be in regular contact with clients, developers, and the internal team.
 

 
 

Responsibilities
 

Project Implementation (80%)
 
 

• Gain the trust of your customers 

• Analyse needs, gather and document requirements, and suggest and implement solutions (configuration, development and testing) 

• Provide training 

• Follow-up and communication about ongoing tasks  

Internal improvement (20%)
 
 

• Feedback to the internal team 

• Mentoring and training 

• Feedback for improvement  

Optional: support other domains such as marketing, HR and accounting at Corlutions (impacts the % split above).
 

 
 

What's great about the job?
 

Expect real responsibility from day one, in a friendly and open environment where you'll work both independently and collaboratively. You'll take on a variety of projects across different industries, broadening your experience along the way. As a bonus, you'll go through an in-depth training provided by Odoo.
 

 
 

What we offer
 
 

• Sponsored events — afterworks and team buildings 

• Trainings — a real learning and development program 

• Green coworking space — we work from Pentagon, a green coworking space surrounded by water in Ghent 

• Sport activity — play any sport with colleagues, the bill might be covered! 

• Eat & drink — fruit basket and coffee on the house  

 
 

Ready to start your adventure? Apply now

Must Have
 
 

• Bachelor or Master's degree 

• Fluent in English and Dutch 

• Strong analytical mindset, with an interest in business analysis 

• Good communication and negotiation skills 

• Autonomous, assertive & proactive 

• Affinity with the IT world, and interest in Odoo, ERP and Business Intelligence tools 

• Learn fast and have a "Can Do" attitude  

Nice to Have
 
 

• Background in Business Administration, Applied Economics, Civil Engineering, Computer Sciences, or Business Intelligence experience 

• Fluent in French 

• Experience across different domains (marketing, HR, accounting) is a plus 

• Technical knowledge (XML, Python, JS, SQL, programming)

jobs.occupation: IT Support Technician – L1 Resident Engineer (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
Do you want to be the face of IT at an international airport site, in a demanding operational environment?

Joining SAL International at Liège Airport means ensuring, day in and day out, the continuity of IT services for a multilingual organisation at the heart of logistics and airport operations.

As part of its growth, SAL International is looking for an L1 IT Support Technician – Resident Engineer based in Liège.

WHY JOIN SAL INTERNATIONAL?

SAL International is an international player in airport handling and logistics. What you will find there:

• A dynamic, operational environment at the heart of Liège Airport
• An international and multilingual setting
• An autonomous role: you are the site's IT point of reference
• A solid structure, backed by central IT teams (L2/L3, infrastructure, network, security

Jobomschrijving

As L1 Resident Engineer, you are the first point of contact for all IT incidents and requests on site. You combine deskside support and helpdesk.

User support

• Provide Level 1 IT support, on site and remotely, to employees at the Liège site
• Diagnose and resolve common incidents: laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, printers, headsets and peripherals
• Support Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 environments (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive), as well as basic application support
• Resolve basic connectivity issues (LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN)
• Support meeting rooms and videoconferencing equipment (Teams, cameras, microphones, screens)
Access and security

• Manage access: accounts, password resets, MFA and authentication, in line with security procedures
• Apply IT security policies and immediately report any suspicious incident (phishing, malware, unauthorised access)
Hardware and lifecycle

• Install, configure and prepare IT equipment (PCs, iOS/Android mobile devices, peripherals)
• Handle IT onboarding and offboarding of employees (workstation preparation, handover and collection of equipment, access rights)
• Keep the IT inventory up to date and coordinate replacements, warranties, repairs and disposals
• Tickets, escalation and coordination
• Log, prioritise, track and close tickets in the ITSM tool (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management…)
• Escalate complex incidents to L2/L3 teams with a full diagnosis, and follow them up in line with SLAs
• Act as the link with central IT teams, service providers and external suppliers
• Inform local management of major incidents or service interruptions
• Contribute to IT documentation (knowledge base, procedures, troubleshooting guides)
You are not just a ticket-taker: you are the local IT point of reference and help ensure the continuity of the site's IT services.

THE TEAM & THE MANAGER

Based at the Liège office, you report directly to the Station Manager, Pierre Jeurissen. You work closely with SAL International's IT teams in Belgium and Saudi Arabia.

Essential

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent technical qualification in IT
• At least 2 years' experience in helpdesk, service desk, desktop support or field support
• Fluent French and English, both spoken and written
• Strong command of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365; basic knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID (Azure AD) and MFA
• Basic knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and cybersecurity
Assets

• Knowledge of Arabic
• Experience as a Resident Engineer / Onsite Support Engineer
• Experience in the aviation or logistics sector, in an international environment
• IT certifications (CompTIA A , ITIL Foundation, Microsoft…)
Soft skills

• Customer focus and service mindset
• Autonomy and rigour in incident management
• Clear communication with non-technical users
• Hands-on, proactive attitude
